description: Global Payments Inc. is a leading payments technology company delivering innovative software and services to its customers globally, with worldwide reach spanning North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America. The payments technology industry provides financial institutions, businesses and consumers with payment processing services, merchant acceptance solutions and related business management software and value-added services, and its technologies, services and team member expertise allow it to provide a broad range of solutions that enable customers to operate their businesses more efficiently across a variety of channels around the world. Headquartered in Georgia with approximately 26,000 team members worldwide, it is a Fortune 500 company and a member of the S&P 500, and it also offers a wide array of business management software solutions, including specialty point-of-sale software, as well as commerce enablement solutions and services, including data analytics and customer engagement, human capital management and payroll, accounts receivable automation, inventory management and reporting.
